none: PAS SUSS-1211F1: Roman Coin: As of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A very worn copper alloy Roman coin, probably an As of Trajan, minted in Rome and dating to AD 114-117. Reverse type: Fortuna Redux; legend reads: FORT . RED . SENATUS POPULUSQUE ROMANUS. Although most of the obverse legend is illegible, the placement of the known portions have assisted in identifying this coin positively, in conjunction with the reverse type and legend. Cf. RIC III, p290, No. 652
